# Shortlink URL Shortener

> Free, fast, and secure URL shortener service to create compact links, custom aliases, and track link analytics in real-time.

## Core Features & Use Cases
- **Custom Slugs**: Create branded short URLs (e.g., `/my-brand`).
- **Click Analytics**: Real-time click counter for link owners.
- **Expiration Control**: Optional expiration dates and click limits for campaign links.
- **REST API**: Programmatic link shortening for developers.

## API Quickstart
- POST `/api/v1/shorten`
  - Body: `{"target_url": "https://example.com", "custom_slug": "my-alias"}`
  - Returns: `{"short_code": "my-alias", "short_url": "https://yourdomain.com/my-alias"}`

## Key Questions & Answers
- What is Shortlink? A modern web application built with FastAPI and React for shortening long URLs into clean, shareable links.
- Is it free? Yes, users can shorten links and manage them for free.
- Does it support custom link aliases? Yes, users can specify custom short paths for their links.
